about: Every number published about the pg_agent_gate / pg_phasevec family, each tied to the run that produced it. tools/validate.py recomputes each check from the run's raw files; a claim whose checks fail cannot be merged. 'source' is the exact sentence as published (see control/numeros-verificados.md, 'Frases listas'); 'text' is how this site states it.

claims.text: Same model, same tasks, a superuser checking what really changed: through a popular Postgres MCP server, 4 of 7 trap tasks broke out. With the database deciding, 0 of 7.

claims.text: With the same gate behind both, the agent without MCP used 5x fewer prompt tokens than through MCP (24k vs 126k for 13 tasks) and finished each task 13x faster: a median of 14 s against 185 s, on a CPU-only CI runner anyone can re-run.
